## Notes

- Game-Turn to calendar week. Every month holds exactly four Game-Turns, weeks I-IV (the Roman numerals of 29.1 are weeks of the month, E-024; no month has a week V). Game-Turn 1 is September III, 1940 and Game-Turn 111, the campaign's last, is January I, 1943.
- Read from the Commonwealth Airplane Reinforcement chart (34.84, jp2 142), which prints each period with its Game-Turns: Sept IV = GT 2, Oct I = GT 3, Nov II = GT 8, Dec I = GT 11, then every month of 1941 and 1942 as four Game-Turns (Jan 1941 = GT 15-18 ... Dec 1942 = GT 107-110).
- Agrees with every other printed date: GT 26 is March 1941 (Rommel's Arrival, 61.2), GT 35 is June I, 1941 (the Port Capacity chart, note a), GT 58 is November IV, 1941 (the German OA sheet), GT 110 is the last week of December 1942 (The Long Retreat, 63.2); and with the seasons (29.1): autumn begins September III, so GT 1-12 are autumn, as E-025's corrected Weather Table bands say.
- week is 1-4 for I-IV. A table keyed by month (axis-convoy-level, simplified-supply, motorisation-losses, cw-production, axis-replacement-pool, seasons) is read through this one.
